children: Star Equity Holdings released an investor presentation detailing pro forma Q2 2026 results, a path to ~$40M adjusted EBITDA by 2030, and $215M of usable NOLs.
Filed investor presentation (as of June 30, 2026) on Sept 22, 2026 under Regulation FD for investor relations transparency.
Q2 2026 TTM pro forma: $223.9M revenue, $92.9M gross profit, $5.9M pro forma adjusted EBITDA.
Vision 2030: target to grow adjusted EBITDA from $6M (Q2 2026 TTM PF) to ~$40M by 2030, excluding acquisitions.
Reports $215M of usable net operating losses providing estimated tax savings ~ $45M (21% tax rate), noted as ~$12.26/share.
Capital structure: market cap $36.9M, enterprise value $66.6M, preferred stock liquidation preference $24.6M; ~$11M repurchased since 2019.
